comment: In the consumer's shipped code, the per-row power-of-two quotient specialisation in #422 has no call site to reach. #422's Rust changes are confined to the `u64x64` example target, which no crate can depend on. The G1 and G6 paths in the Charon store reach no per-row stock quotient: their mask predicates compare a stock lane against a scalar threshold (G6: `d * q`, built at method registration), and mask-risc evaluates `GeI32` as a plain compare. Not covered: mask-risc predicates other than `GeI32`, and G1's unshipped per-store min/argmin step (EXO-227 P1b).

In shipped code, a per-row quotient specialisation has nothing to apply to.
